rules.DEADLINE: Early (1-30) 7th business day after today; late (31-90) 3rd business day after today.
rules.FLOOR: Card minimum_payment, loan instalment_amount, overdraft 25% rounded up to whole dollar, min $25 (whole debt below $25).
rules.LADDER: After a refused opening ask: step 1 full on deadline, step 2 floor on deadline; 2 attempts per band; then NO_PAY note.
rules.CODES: DISPUTED / CLAIMS_PAID / NO_PAY / SYS_FAIL notes; hardship transfers straight to support.
rules.CONV: Products in order overdraft, card, loan (larger past_due first within a type); partial proposals take the missing part from the table; below-floor counter-offer at the floor on the customer's date; late date countered with the deadline; one date for all clamps to each deadline; read-back corrections re-checked and re-read; record only after an explicit yes; close ranking by first non-paid product.
